evidence_allowed_for_selection: frozen qldebugger dependency range and absence of a committed poetry.lock
simulation-visible tests with the named withheld test excluded
configured workflow and Makefile test commands
absence of retained exact-head workflow execution evidence
unresolved_behavior_question: Does the externally observable exception behavior of ConfigLambda(handler=<non-string>) change when the target crosses from a Pydantic 1.10.x environment into Pydantic 2.x?

input.reason: A non-string value deterministically executes the exact target branch that raises TypeError.

comparison_environments.selection_reason: 1.10.9 is a real Pydantic V1 release from 2023-06-07, satisfies the old ^1.10 constraint, predates the PR, and represents the old validator exception semantics.
2.0.0 is the exact major-line boundary surfaced by the Dependabot PR and official migration material; using the boundary avoids time-dependent resolution to a later 2.x version.

selected_check.observation: Capture the exception class and message produced by constructing ConfigLambda with the same non-string handler in both environments.

expected_discrimination_from_upstream_ev.pydantic_1_10_9: TypeError raised inside the validator is expected to be represented through Pydantic ValidationError behavior.
expected_discrimination_from_upstream_ev.pydantic_2_0_0: The validator's TypeError is expected to propagate directly rather than being converted to ValidationError.

why_this_check_is_selected: It executes the exact target-owned branch mapped to the authoritative upstream change.
The two-version comparison isolates the dependency-major semantic difference instead of relying on an unpreserved historical resolver result.
It answers a narrower question than running the complete test suite and makes the information gained attributable to one behavior boundary.
It does not require inferring that the repository necessarily promises a particular public exception contract; it first establishes whether target-observable behavior changes.

alternatives_considered.check: run the entire repository test suite under an unconstrained fresh install
alternatives_considered.reason: Broader and more expensive; exact resolved Pydantic version can drift; a pass/fail result would provide weaker attribution to the mapped TypeError behavior.
Import success does not execute ConfigLambda._split_handler or the TypeError branch.

alternatives_considered.check: construct ConfigLambda with an ordinary valid string handler under Pydantic V2
alternatives_considered.reason: The valid-input path does not execute the TypeError branch implicated by the upstream behavior change.
It can establish which Pydantic version is installed but cannot determine the target behavior at the activated branch.

information_value.if_behavior_differs_as_expected: Confirms that the mapped upstream semantic change produces an observable difference on the exact target branch; the remaining question becomes whether that behavior matters to the repository contract/policy.
information_value.if_behavior_does_not_differ: Challenges the mapping, environment construction, or assumed upstream applicability and justifies investigating those specific causes before broader compatibility analysis.
what_a_pass_cannot_prove: maintainer acceptance of either exception contract

stop_after_selection: Proceed to oracle comparison; do not broaden into general Pydantic migration analysis.
